summary: Tested the new /admin/login page, the admin route guards, the links to the admin login, the player login regression and the site_url origin whitelist for email/referral links. Backend 15/15 pytest pass. Frontend: all requested flows pass.
verified: Owner admin login -> /admin with full nav incl. Staff + Credit Config; owner visiting /admin/login -> /admin
Staff login -> /admin Staff Console with no Credit Config nav; /admin/settings -> /admin; staff visiting /admin/login -> /admin
Player on admin login -> 'doesn't have admin access' error; /api/auth/me 401 afterwards
Player /login password mode -> /app; OTP toggle renders; player /admin -> /app

site_url: Origin scarmenta.com / www.scarmenta.com is used in the referral link; evil origin and no origin fall back to FRONTEND_URL; forgot-password returns 200 for both; unit test of core.site_url passes
CORS reflects only whitelisted origins, with credentials=true
db.users role=admin count == 1; admin hash is $2b$
critical_code_review_comments: A logged-in player visiting /admin/login sees the form (not redirected). Acceptable, since it allows switching to an admin account, but it could show a 'signed in as player' hint.
AdminLogin with player credentials briefly sets session cookies before calling logout. Works, but a server-side admin-only login flag would be cleaner.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest without -p no:xdist (pytest.ini uses xdist). test_admin_login_site_url.py covers the admin login and origin whitelist.
